item.title: How E. Honda can apparently hit his sweep three times in a single combo in Street Fighter 6
item.description:
Generally speaking, the sweep usually marks the ending of an interaction within a fighting game between two players. This is especially true in Street Fighter 6.

For a character to combo into a sweep, we typically see it as being the last hit of the combo since it tends to knock the opponent down. However, every now and again, some sweeps have special properties that allow characters to continue the combo after landing one.

item.title: New animation highlights collaboration between Magic Chess: Go Go and The King of Fighters
item.description:
There's apparently a collaboration that's happening between Magic Chess: Go Go and SNK's The King of Fighters. Magic Chess: Go Go is a mobile game of the "auto battler" genre that can be played by up to eight players at a time.

A special trailer was recently released to promote the collaborative event. This trailer pitted iconic combatants from The King of Fighters series up against characters from Magic Chess: Go Go.
